Class ShopAPI

java.lang.Object
com.atomictempest.shop.api.ShopAPI
public final class ShopAPI extends Object
The shop, for other plugins: read what it sells and buys, and add, change or remove items. Declare "AtomicTempest:Shop": "*" under Dependencies (or OptionalDependencies, and check isAvailable()) in your manifest.json. Purchases and sales are also reported through Coins' PlayerActions.
